acceptance criterion, the honesty of result categories, coverage of negative and recovery cases, accessibility
and responsive evidence for UI, and the release checklist (rollback tested, backup restore tested, monitoring,
support docs, human approval). Return GO / GO_WITH_ACCEPTED_RISKS / NO_GO with blockers and tests not run.
